contract.migration: Existing document policies inherit workspace access; missing legacy policies inherit membership only for a document whose workspace can be established.
contract.restricted_collection: Current workspace admins and the document owner retain access independently of collection grants. Other current members need an explicit collection read/write grant; write additionally requires researcher/admin role.
contract.revocation: Revoking a collection grant hides dependent private runs, report bodies/downloads/series/diffs/impacts/revisions and semantic summaries. It does not revoke the document owner's independent permission.
contract.snapshots: ACL changes affect visibility; stored report text, source excerpts and SHA-256 remain unchanged. Retained document policies keep frozen report visibility decidable even when current original rows/chunks are absent.
contract.memory: Personal profile/preferences remain subject-owned. A semantic summary follows the source run's author/admin visibility and every local document's current ACL; it is not a permission bypass through workspace memory sharing.
contract.concurrency_boundary: SSE rechecks current role and source ACL before each next event batch. Bytes already selected/sent under a preceding authorization cannot be recalled. Publication/revision and grant mutations share the workspace row lock; final execution also fences current source permissions.

fixed_review_gaps: Java submit replay and revise previously read a frozen source without the current document ACL check.
Report series previously exposed historical report metadata without per-report source ACL filtering; an inaccessible current report id is now hidden.
Python owned_run, conversation bulk exports and SSE previously relied only on workspace membership.

DocumentAccessService previously treated unknown/nonexistent or cross-workspace document identifiers as legacy allowed records; it now fails closed when source ownership cannot be established.
Collection input null permissions and stale membership lock handling now reject explicitly.
